Obviously this could lead to some problems in certain subverses, so I'm not asking for this to be enabled by default, but it would be nice to have the option to enable this for smaller subs. I run an extremely small subverse, and currently I'm pretty much the only person posting, it would be nice to be able to queue up posts so that they post at specific times of day so that there is always new content for people. The idea being that by keeping the subverse active throughout all times of day it will help people to become invested in the subverse and lead to more submissions.

Having a hard cap would make sense, something like 10 posts queued up per day for the site, in order to keep down server stress, and keep it form being abused, but it would also be nice to allow subverses themselves to choose how many each user can post to their particular subverse if they choose to enable it.

Obviously it's kind of a niche option, but I feel like it would really open up some options for people who want to help keep things active, especially on smaller subs, when they don't have the ability to be active at certain times of day. I also believe it could be useful for announcement posts, or even event posts, in order to ensure that certain posts appear on time.

Just let users do any captchas necessary in advance, and I don't see why this would be any easier to abuse then just manually posting at specific times.

By extension, it would also be nice to be able to queue up comments, and even comments on queued up posts. Something like queuing up comments for things like AMA's for notifications about when discussions will end, times in which people will be back, or times where people will be taking a break. Or, how I intend to use it, queuing up Source information and links to Artist's pages for Post's I've not yet made.
Ability to queue up a small number of posts to be posted at specific times.
